actions.reason: .env defines PAYMENT_TOKEN but app reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN (log: not set, provider 401); renaming key keeps existing value.

root_causes.evidence: .env defined PAYMENT_TOKEN, but app.py reads PAYMENTS_TOKEN. Shop log said 'PAYMENTS_TOKEN is not set' and the payments connector returned 401 on /charge. Checkout returned 502.

report.summary: Checkout failed with a 502 because the token key in .env was misnamed (PAYMENT_TOKEN instead of PAYMENTS_TOKEN). The shop sent no credentials and the provider rejected the charge with a 401. I renamed the key and kept the existing value. I then restarted the shop. All 5 smoke tests pass, and checkout now returns 201 with the order persisted.
